summary.tldr: Eliminates interest on federal student and apprentice loans, and changes when borrowers have to start repaying them.
what_it_does: Eliminates interest on student loans during periods of study for both full-time and part-time students, and bars any fee on a student loan for that time.
Delays repayment of student loans until the last day of the seventh month after a borrower stops being a student, or stops being a full-time student for full-time loans.
Eliminates interest on guaranteed student loans made on or after August 1, 1993, and removes older sections that set the previous interest rules.
Eliminates interest on apprentice loans and says repayment starts after the prescribed deferral period.
Keeps the current rules for principal and interest that were already payable before the bill comes into force, until those amounts are repaid.
summary.background: The bill amends the Canada Student Financial Assistance Act, the Canada Student Loans Act and the Apprentice Loans Act.
